blocks.html: Following a repair or adjustment at a site, the sidewalk shed shall be inspected by a qualified person designated by the designer, the permit holder for the shed, or a third party acceptable to both the designer and the permit holder to verify the adequacy of the repair or adjustment and to verify the sidewalk shed is in a safe condition and is in compliance with drawings and the requirements of this chapter.
